name: session-journal
description: Record Codex sessions to an Obsidian vault (or a subfolder of an existing one) with summaries, durable wiki notes, and wikilinks. Every generated note is tagged #ai-generated to stay distinct from hand-authored notes.

interface.shortDescription: Record agent sessions into an Obsidian vault.
interface.longDescription: Capture Claude Code and Codex prompts, tool activity, and final results through lifecycle hooks; write append-only raw logs, readable session summaries, durable wiki notes, and Obsidian wikilinks for graph navigation.
defaultPrompt: Show where session-journal writes Obsidian notes.
Explain how wiki-worthy notes are selected.
